name: Synthwave Web
summary: A neon sunset, a perspective grid, chrome type, pink and cyan on deep violet, and scanlines. It recalls the 1980s as film and games sold it, and it feels like a night drive.

philosophy.core_thesis: The 1980s as a dream: neon, chrome and a road to the horizon.
design_principles: Set the ground as a gradient from #12062B at the top to #3A0A5C at the horizon.
Draw a sun of 240px to 480px with a gradient from #FFD319 to #FF2975 and 5 to 8 horizontal cuts that grow from 2px to 10px.
Draw a perspective grid on the floor with lines of 1px to 2px in #FF2975 or #00F0FF, 12 to 20 lines, with a vanishing point at 50% width.
Give headlines a chrome gradient (white to pink to violet) and a glow of 8px to 24px in pink at 60%.
Use only 3 neon hues: pink (#FF2975), cyan (#00F0FF) and yellow (#FFD319) on violet.
Overlay scanlines of 2px at 8% opacity and a vignette at 30%.
Slide the grid toward the viewer at 1 grid cell per 2s in a loop.
anti_patterns: Thin light text with no glow

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred stage: sun and horizon at 40% to 60% height, a grid floor beneath, headline above the sun; sections stack in dark panels.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 50% of the surface is empty sky and floor; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero; text in panels flush left; stats in neon columns.
layout.container_geometry: Panels with a 2px neon border and 8px radius or none; pills for buttons at 999px.

font_pairings.note: A wide techno display for headlines.
A rounded wide display with an 80s voice.
A line-cut display for logos and short words.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 400 and 700 for display and 400 for body.
Set headlines in upper case with chrome fill.
Set body at 16px in a plain sans for reading.

color.palette_structure: Deep violet with hot pink, cyan and a sun yellow.
color.contrast_rules: Mist on night holds 15:1; neon pink and cyan hold at least 4.5:1 on night for 18px and larger.
color.surface_treatment: Vertical gradients, a sun disc, a vignette and scanlines.
color.light_and_shadow: Emissive: glows of 8px to 24px blur in pink or cyan at 40% to 60%.

materiality.surface_simulation: Neon tube, chrome and a CRT screen at night.
materiality.border_rules: 2px neon border in pink or cyan with a 8px glow.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Glow 8px to 24px; vignette at 30%; no soft grey shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Neon line icons of 2px with a glow; chrome stars and palm trees.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Sun disc, perspective grid, mountains, palm silhouettes and retro cars.

motion.transition_physics: Smooth and endless: the grid flows toward the viewer; the sun pulses by 4% every 4s; text glows flicker for 80ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the glow of a neon item by 30% and shifts it up 2px; active state dims it by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a nostalgic night drive and a bright, synthetic future.

avoid_when: The brand needs a calm, serious tone.
The audience needs high contrast with no glow.

modifiers.how: Keep the violet ground and one cyan accent; remove sun, grid and glow.
Use pastel pink and teal with statues and a sans label.
Replace pink with acid green and add HUD frames.

pack.why: A smooth 2px line that takes a neon glow well.
